title: List connected accounts
description:
Read-only, free. The social platforms currently connected to your account.
`channel_group` = one channel group (integer, 0 = primary) or `all`.

use_cases.title: 🔌 Connected accounts
use_cases.description: No params — returns each connected platform + username + status of the primary channel group.

use_cases.title: 🌐 Every channel group
use_cases.description: `channel_group=all` lists the accounts of every channel group; each row carries channel_group + channel_group_label.
